subject: I-O status
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 9.1.13.5 "The prime record key value has been changed by the runtime element between the successful execution of a READ statement" -> OK §9.1.13.5 1)). Two arms, both located and both probed: (i) ascending-sequence violation - IndexedConnector.Write, sequential access only (§14.9.51.4 GR38/GR42 a), not-greater-than the last prime written through THIS connector (and, under extend, the highest existing - l1_open_extend_position XW2=21); probe iostat-ix SW2-SEQ=21 (descending) and SW3-EQ=21 (equal - '21' and '22' both apply; the implementor's choice under §9.1.13.1, cite.py OK). (ii) prime key changed between READ and REWRITE - IndexedConnector.Rewrite sequential-access arm compares with KeyEq (collating sequence, §12.4.5.12.4 GR1) against _lastReadPrime; probe SRW-CHG=21. Random/dynamic access never yields '21' (rule scoped to a sequentially accessed file). The golden covers arm (i) only; arm (ii) has no spec-derived golden (KeyedIoDifferentialTests is a legacy differential and does not qualify).
